_meta.description: Rolling stock for Line 9. Trains run now (Dahisar (E) to Kashigaon), through from Line 7: six-car BEML trains of the Line 2A and 7 fleet, from MMRDA's order MRS1 (2018; Press Information Bureau, 22 Nov 2018) and its additions. 'in_service' is the section's opening paragraph. 'specs' are MMRDA's car figures for Lines 9 and 7A. No source gives how many trains run on Line 9. No image is sourced.

in_service.summary: Line 9 runs as one service with Line 7: BEML-built trains go through from Gundavali to Kashigaon. They are of the fleet MMRDA ordered from BEML in 2018 for Lines 2A, 2B and 7. No source gives how many of them run on Line 9, or which of the orders they came from.

procurement.value: The Government's release of 22 Nov 2018: 378 cars (63 trains of 6 cars) for Lines 2A, 2B and 7, Rs 3,015 crore
procurement.scope: Design, manufacture, supply, testing and commissioning of the cars, with spares and training
procurement.notes: Press Information Bureau (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, 22 Nov 2018) names Lines 2A, 2B and 7 for the 378 cars; BEML was the lowest of seven bidders. No source read names an order for Line 9 itself. Free Press Journal (Apr 2026): Line 7 is integrated with Line 9; (Jan 2026): Line 9's trains are kept at Line 7's Charkop depot. Metro Rail Today (Sep 2025): BEML-built trains on Line 9.

specs.label: MMRDA's figures for Lines 9 and 7A.
specs.notes: MMRDA's page lists the car size and an eight-car capacity for Lines 9 and 7A; the trains running now have six cars (reported).

facts.label: On Line 9
facts.value: The trains run through from Gundavali on Line 7 to Kashigaon, and are kept at Charkop, Line 7's depot, until the Dongri depot is built

facts.label: Trials
facts.value: The Research Designs and Standards Organisation's speed and brake trials of BEML trains on Line 9 reached 90 km/h (September 2025)

facts.label: Designed for
facts.value: Driverless running, regenerative braking, CCTV for riders and for watching the track ahead, full air conditioning

facts.label: The maker's description
facts.value: Six-car trains for unattended train operation (UTO), with a train control and management system (TCMS), built to the EN 45545 HL3 fire standard

facts.label: Supply
facts.value: At the award, supply was to begin in October 2020 and end in December 2022; the cars are built at BEML's factory in Bengaluru, with Hitachi for some designs

facts.label: Later orders
facts.value: BEML got two more orders under the same contract: 126 cars (21 trains, Rs 834 crore, August 2019) and 72 cars (12 trains, Rs 501 crore, November 2020), for 576 cars, 96 trains, in all. The Metro Rail Guy gives these for Lines 2A and 7
